description: Shared PTZ dwell admission conformance vectors (Controller and Tracker). See tests/data/ptz/README.md.

vectors.name: no_pose_received
vectors.description: Only resolver status, no PoseContext yet.

vectors.name: admit_after_full_dwell
vectors.description: Dwell 1.2 s - 0.02 s uncertainty >= 1.0 s; observation equal to latest stationary timestamp.

vectors.name: reject_observation_newer_than_latest_stationary
vectors.description: Observation 1 us after the latest stationary PoseContext.

vectors.name: observation_at_stationary_since_boundary
vectors.description: observation - max_detection_timestamp_uncertainty == stationary_since is admitted; one epsilon earlier is rejected.

vectors.name: dwell_fails_only_with_uncertainty
vectors.description: Elapsed 1.0 s meets latency without uncertainty but 1.0 - 0.02 < 1.0 with it.

vectors.name: dwell_passes_with_zero_uncertainty
vectors.description: Same timeline with zero pose uncertainty: elapsed 1.0 s >= 1.0 s is admitted (inclusive).

vectors.name: dwell_boundary_epsilon
vectors.description: Elapsed exactly 1.02 s with 0.02 s uncertainty is admitted; 1 us less is rejected.

vectors.name: dwell_boundary_epsilon_short
vectors.description: Elapsed 1.019999 s with 0.02 s uncertainty is rejected.

vectors.name: sequence_gap_resets_dwell
vectors.description: Sequence 1004 is missing; dwell restarts at 1005 and completes only at 1011.

vectors.name: non_increasing_sequence_resets_dwell
vectors.description: A repeated sequence number restarts dwell at that PoseContext.

vectors.name: non_increasing_timestamp_resets_dwell
vectors.description: Contiguous sequence with a timestamp that does not increase restarts dwell.

vectors.name: resolver_session_change_resets_dwell
vectors.description: New resolver session timestamp resets dwell although the source sequence stays contiguous.

vectors.name: duplicate_status_same_session_keeps_dwell
vectors.description: A repeated status for the same session does not reset dwell.

vectors.name: resolver_offline_resets_dwell
vectors.description: Resolver LWT (offline) resets dwell; it restarts after the session comes back.

vectors.name: motion_settling_recovery
vectors.description: Stationary, then slewing and settling (invalid), then a full new dwell.

vectors.name: valid_pose_not_stationary
vectors.description: Defensive: valid PoseContext whose motion_state is not stationary never admits.

vectors.name: source_mismatch_resets_dwell
vectors.description: A PoseContext for another source resets dwell and is otherwise ignored.

vectors.name: frame_mismatch
vectors.description: PoseContext frame_id differs from the consumer's scene frame.

vectors.name: calibration_mismatch
vectors.description: PoseContext calibration_version differs from the Manager-loaded version.

vectors.name: calibration_change_mid_dwell
vectors.description: Consumer does not pin a version; a calibration_version change restarts dwell.

vectors.name: freshness_valid_until_boundary
vectors.description: local_now 1 us before valid_until is fresh; at valid_until it is stale.

vectors.name: freshness_local_max_age
vectors.description: valid_until is later than the local bound; local max_pose_age_s still expires the pose.

vectors.name: detection_age_boundary
vectors.description: Detection age equal to max_detection_pipeline_latency_s is admitted; 1 us older is rejected.

vectors.name: invalid_pose_reasons
vectors.description: Every Resolver reason_detail is reported with its canonical invalid_reason.
